title: Divisorial ideals and $v$-class semigroups of strictly closed domains
summary: We study divisorial ideals and the $v$-class semigroup of a Noetherian domain satisfying Serre's condition $(S_2)$. We prove that strict closedness is equivalent to Clifford $v$-regularity and describe the structure of the associated $v$-class semigroup. We use these results to characterize finite generation of the class semigroup and Boole $v$-regularity. We also construct prime ideal decompositions of integrally closed divisorial ideals and clarify the relationship between these decompositions and local Boole $v$-regularity.
